description_en: Thephalcā's was most likely built in 1980 CE. There are no visual records of thephalcāin photographs by Ganesman Chitrakar (ca. 1960), Bob Frank (1968), and Carl Pruscha (ca. 1972). An inscription from NS 1100 (LAL4310_I_001) records the "restoration" of thephalcāin 1980 which appears unlikely. It is possible that the inscription actually refers to the reconstruction of the Samay Phalca (LAL4317) that used to be located just to the south. Could it be that Samay Phalcā was demolished in 1972 CE and subsequently rebuilt in 1980 CE as Nāmasaṅgīti Phalcā, about 10 metres further to the north?Another inscription attests to an extension to the western side of Nāmasaṅgīti Phalcā in 2013.In 2020, the Nāmasaṅgīti Phalcā was undergoing restoration once again. A new concrete pitched roof, covered withjhĩgaṭītiles, was added to the flat concrete slab roof, giving the structure a more traditional appearance. The concrete pillars were clad with newly madedāci apābricks.A group known as Nāmasaṅgīti Khalaḥ has been established by residents of Pulchok. This collective gathers to chant the Nāmasaṅgīti texts on auspicious occasions such as the 1st, 8th, and full moon days of each month. Musical instruments required for these recitations are stored behind thephalcā. Statues of Umāmaheśvara, Gaṇeśa, Nṛsiḥa, Padmapāṇi, Lokeśvara, Tārā and Nāmasaṅgitī have been installed on the building's northern wall.
description_ne: पाटनको मध्यकालीन नगरक्षेत्र वाहिर चारै दिशामा समान स्वरूपका स्तूपहरू रहेका छन् । यी स्तूपलाई स्थानीय भाषामा प्यंगः थूर (चारवटा थुव) भन्ने चलन छ । पूर्वको तेताथूर (थुव/स्तुप), पश्चिमको पूच्वथूर, उत्तरको ईबहीथूर र दक्षिणमा भएको थूर लगंथूर कहलाउँछ । यी चारमध्ये पश्चिमको पूच्वथूरको अगाडि यो फल्चा बनाइएको छ । फल्चाको निर्माण मिति निक्र्यौल गर्न सकिने कुनै अभिलेख प्राप्त छैन ।Bob Frankद्वारा सन् १९६८ मा खिचिएको थूरको फोटोमा यो फल्चा पनि देख्न सकिन्छ । उक्त फोटोमा फल्चा तीन कवलको भएको र परम्परागत झिंगटीले छानो छाइएको देख्न सकिन्छ ।  फल्चालाई सन् १९८० मा जीर्णोद्धार गरिएको अलिभेख फल्चाभित्र टाँसिएको छ । परम्परागत शैलीको फल्चालाई सन् २०१३ मा सिमेन्टको प्रयोग गरी पुनःनिर्माण गरिएको थियो । सिमेन्टबाट बनेको र छानो ढलान गरिएको (concrete slab on top) फल्चालाई परम्परागत स्वरूप दिन महानगरपालिकाले सन् २०२० मा बजेट निकासा गरेको छ । फल्चाको चौतर्फी गारो दाचि अप्पाले ढाक्ने र ढलान गरिएको छानो (concrete slab on top) लाई परम्परागत पाखो स्वरूप दिने काम महानगरपालिकाबाट भैरहेको छ   ।फल्चामा संक्रान्ती, अष्टमी, पूर्णिमा जस्ता शुभ दिनहरूमा पुल्चोकवासीहरूको सहभागिता रहेको नामसङ्गीति खलः (समूह) ले नामसंङ्गीति पाठ गर्दैै आएको छ । पाठका क्रममा आवश्यक सांतीतिक सामग्री फल्चाकै पछाडिको तहरोमा संग्रह गरिएको छ । फल्चाको उत्तरी भित्तामा उमामहेश्वर, गणेश, नृसिंह, पद्मपाणि लोकेश्वर, तारा र नामसङ्गीतिका मूर्ति टाँसिएका छन् ।

historical_events.event_description: This inscription records the restoration of thephalcāin 1980 which seems unlikely since at this time thephalcāwould not have been older than 7 years. It is possible that the inscription actually refers to the reconstruction of the Samay Phalca (LAL4317) that used to be located just to the south. Could it be that Samay Phalcā was demolished in the late 1970s and subsequently rebuilt in 1980 CE as Nāmasaṅgīti Phalcā, about 10 metres further to the north?
Inscriptions on three marble panels (one of which is broken) attest to the restoration of thephalcā.The three marble panels were formerly attached to the outer western wall of thephalcā's extension.

In 2020, the Nāmasaṅgīti Phalcā was undergoing restoration once again. With the financial support of the Lalitpur Metropolitan City office, a new concrete pitched roof, covered withjhĩgaṭītiles, was added to the flat concrete slab roof, giving the structure a more traditional appearance. The concrete pillars were clad with newly madedāci apābricks.
